name: NA Stadium Series - Edmonton 2024
information:
We are happy to announce the third competition in the North American Stadium Series as it moves from the gridiron to the ice and crosses into Canada! Our third stop is Edmonton's modern downtown cathedral to hockey, Rogers Place. This competition will offer a very unique experience for speedcubers and hockey fans alike. You won't want to miss it! Please see below and other tabs for very important information.
